title: Creamy Indian Pot Fondue
description: A rich and creamy fondue dish that combines the flavors of India with the comfort of a pot of fondue. Serve with an assortment of vegetables and bread for a fun and interactive dining experience.
instructions: Heat the fondue in a pot over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and let them sizzle for 1-2 minutes.
Add the korma and velvety to the pot and stir until well combined.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Serve the fondue hot with an assortment of vegetables and bread.
Enjoy the creamy and flavorful fondue!
